capabilities: Syncs vault files with one GitLab branch over HTTPS REST API
Creates ordinary Git commits with a configured author name and email
Auto-merges text conflicts and keeps both versions as conflict copies
Triggers sync on startup, edits, timer, and app foreground/background
Stores the GitLab token in Obsidian SecretStorage and keeps sync state local
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.11.4+; AGPL-3.0 licensed. GitLab-only, one project and one branch; no merge, rebase, force push, branch switching, LFS, submodules, symlinks or multiple remotes; background sync on mobile is unstable.
intentEvidence: independently maintained GitLab rewrite, based on GitHub Gitless Sync by Silvano Cerza
problem: Git cannot be installed on mobile devices, so there is no way to keep a vault in sync with a self-hosted or gitlab.com repository without it.

relations.evidence: independently maintained GitLab rewrite, based on GitHub Gitless Sync by Silvano Cerza

requires.name: GitLab account with a project (gitlab.com or self-managed)
GitLab fine-grained or project access token

summary: Syncs an Obsidian vault with a single GitLab repository branch over the GitLab REST API, with no local Git required.
